title: 第21章 化为血食！
novel_title: 宗门收徒，我能看见属性词条
content_zh:
面前的并非是等待开采的狭窄矿脉。

    而是开阔的仪式场地，几颗诡异的头颅高挂在最高处的祭祀台上。

    还有六名身着宽大黑袍人，盘坐在六个方位，吸纳四周血池的血气。

    血迹斑斑的祭祀台上也不知道有多少人丧命于此。

    围绕祭祀台的则是范围广阔的人工血池，正对方向有四座奇异至极的雕像，它们表情各异。

    但目光之中似乎暗带凶光，怒目而视中央祭台。

    血池之中尸体遍布，妖兽，人类都有，尸体干瘪无比，但又浮现暗红色的能量。

    从厉行天脚下有一条只能供两人通行的道路，直达祭祀台中央，随后贯穿整个祭祀台到达对面。

    他瞳孔震惊，目光望向四周的人，却发现所有人似乎都没有任何异常。

    他们此刻似乎还自以为在拥挤的管道之中，挤着小小的矿道，向最深处走去。

    这是……大范围的幻境？

    筑基期能免疫这种幻术，还是什么东西能使自己抵御这种环境？

    厉行天压下心中不安，选择暂时依旧跟随人群，得先弄懂清风宗到底在做什么，明白身后到底是什么存在。

    计划很可能在见到这一幕的时候将要被全部推翻。

    清风宗的本质莫非真的是邪教？

    厉行天低着头，小心翼翼跟随人群，缓缓走过路中央的祭台。

    穿过祭台，再往里面深入，就是正常的矿场，所有人都手握开采工具，准备开采。

    矿场目前来看还是真矿场，但是……那个祭祀仪轨到底是什么东西？

    这个疑惑当第一个手持镐子，开挖的矿工动手时，厉行天就瞬间恍然大悟。

    随着每一次挖矿，有股淡淡暗红色的能量从矿工的天灵盖上幽幽飘起，向血池涌去。

    里面所有的矿工都是同样，一缕缕的暗红色能量逐渐汇聚，也是一股不能小觑的能量。

    厉行天目光紧紧盯着一个矿工，猛然发现这股暗红色的能量似乎是从灵根之中被榨出的。

    消耗的不单单是矿工的血肉和灵气，而是连修仙基础的灵根都在被磨损。

    难怪那群矿工看上去都如此骨瘦如柴，天天干活还被榨取血肉，能不骨瘦如柴吗？

    这是纯粹的邪修技术，而且闻所未闻，并且阵法范围如此之大！

    厉行天不敢开挖，因为观察来看提供的血气是根据灵根以及修为水准来决定多少。
content_en:
What lies before us is not a narrow vein of minerals waiting to be mined.

Instead, it was an open ceremony venue, with several weird heads hanging high on the highest sacrificial platform.

There are also six people in wide black robes, sitting cross-legged in six directions, absorbing the blood energy from the surrounding blood pools.

It is unknown how many people died on the blood-stained altar.

Surrounding the sacrificial altar is a vast artificial blood pool, and in the opposite direction are four extremely strange statues with different expressions.

But there seemed to be a hint of ferocity in his eyes, and he glared at the central altar.

There were corpses everywhere in the blood pool, including monsters and humans. The corpses were extremely shriveled, but dark red energy emerged.

From the foot of Li Xingtian, there is a road that can only be used by two people, which goes straight to the center of the sacrificial platform, and then runs through the entire sacrificial platform to the opposite side.

His pupils were shocked, and he looked at the people around him, but found that no one seemed to have anything abnormal.

At this moment, they seemed to think that they were in a crowded pipeline, squeezing through the small mine tunnel and walking towards the deepest part.

Is this... a large-scale illusion?

Can I be immune to this illusion during the foundation building stage, or is there something that can make me resist this environment?

Li Xingtian suppressed his uneasiness and chose to follow the crowd for the time being. He had to first understand what the Qingfeng Sect was doing and what was behind him.

The plan will most likely be overturned when seeing this scene.

Is the essence of Qingfeng Sect really a cult?

Li Xingtian lowered his head and carefully followed the crowd, slowly walking past the altar in the middle of the road.

Passing through the altar and going deeper inside is a normal mine, where everyone holds mining tools and is ready to mine.

At present, the mine is still a real mine, but... what exactly is that sacrificial ritual?

This doubt suddenly dawned on Li Xingtian when the first miner started digging with a pickaxe.

With every mining operation, a faint dark red energy floated faintly from the miner's Heavenly Spirit Cap and surged towards the blood pool.

All the miners inside are the same. Wisps of dark red energy are gradually gathering. It is also an energy that cannot be underestimated.

Li Xingtian stared closely at a miner and suddenly realized that the dark red energy seemed to be squeezed out of the spiritual root.

Not only the flesh, blood and spiritual energy of the miners are consumed, but even the spiritual roots that are the foundation of immortality are being worn away.

No wonder those miners all looked so skinny. They worked every day and had their flesh and blood squeezed out of them. How could they not be so skinny?

This is a pure evil cultivating technique, and it is unheard of, and the range of the formation is so large!

Li Xingtian didn't dare to dig because the amount of blood energy provided was determined based on spiritual roots and cultivation level.
